Rashi on Sotah 45b:10:1.hebrew: מכוון - מצומצם, שאין זו קרובה לו מזו אפי' כמלא חוט:
Rashi on Sotah 45b:10:1.english: Precisely - Exact, [meaning] that this [city] is not closer to him than that [one] even by a thread's breadth.

Rashi on Sotah 45b:10:2.hebrew: ואין ירושלים כו' - מפרש טעמא בגמ':
Rashi on Sotah 45b:10:2.english: And Jerusalem does not, etc. - [It] explains the reason in the Gemara.

Rashi on Sotah 45b:10:3.hebrew: מוליכין הראש אצל הגוף - בגמ' מפרש למאי הלכתא מוליכין:
Rashi on Sotah 45b:10:3.english: They bring the head next to the body - In the Gemara [it] explains for what halakha they bring [it].

Rashi on Sotah 45b:11:1.hebrew: אפשר לצמצם - אפשר לכוין המדה, ואמת מדדו שאין זו קרובה לו מזו כלל, והוו להו שתיהן קרובות:
Rashi on Sotah 45b:11:1.english: It is possible to measure precisely - It is possible to make the measurement exact, and in truth they measured [it] such that this [city] is not closer to it than that [city] at all, and [thus] both of them are [considered] nearest.

Rashi on Sotah 45b:11:2.hebrew: וקסבר - נמי, קרובה דכתיב בקרא אפילו קרובות במשמע, כמו ובהמה רבה (יונה ד). דאס"ד אי אפשר לצמצם, אין כאן קרובה אלא אחת, ואנן הוא דלא ידעינן הי מינייהו, והוה ליה למימר: יביאו עגלה בשותפות ויתנו: אם שלנו קרובה — חלקכם יהא קנוי לנו, ואם עירכם קרובה — חלקנו יהא קנוי לכם:
Rashi on Sotah 45b:11:2.english: And he holds - also [that] "nearest," which is written in the verse, implies even [multiple] "nearest" [cities], like "and much cattle" (Jonah 4). For if it would enter your mind [that] it is impossible to measure precisely, there is only one nearest [city] here, and it is [merely] that we do not know which of them [it is], and he should have said: They bring [one] heifer in partnership and stipulate: "If ours is nearest, let your share be acquired by us; and if your city is nearest, let our share be acquired by you."

Rashi on Sotah 45b:13:1.hebrew: אילימא לענין מדידה - קאמר יביאו הראש אצל הגוף, דממקום שנמצא הגוף שם צריך למדוד, ויביאו הראש לכאן. והא מדקתני כו':
Rashi on Sotah 45b:13:1.english: If we say with regard to measurement - [that is,] it means [that] they should bring the head to the body, because from the place where the body was found, there one must measure, and [therefore] they should bring the head here. "And from [the fact] that it teaches, etc."

Rashi on Sotah 45b:13:2.hebrew: קנה מקומו - לקוברו שם, דזה אחד מי' תנאים שהתנה יהושע בפרק מרובה (ב"ק דף פא.):
Rashi on Sotah 45b:13:2.english: Acquires its place - To bury it there, for this is one of the ten conditions that Joshua stipulated in the chapter [entitled] Merubah (Bava Kamma 81a).

Rashi on Sotah 45b:15:1.hebrew: עיקר חיותא כו' - הלכך עיקר חלל מיקרי, ומודדין מיניה, כדכתיב: "אל הערים אשר סביבות החלל":
Rashi on Sotah 45b:15:1.english: [His] life is mainly, etc. - Therefore, it is called the main [part of the] corpse, and they measure from it, as it is written: "to the cities that are around the corpse."

Rashi on Sotah 45b:16:1.hebrew: אתה גוזי - אתה מראשי יצרת, ראשי תחילה, דגוזי לישנא דרישא, כמו גזי נזרך — שער ראשך תלשי וגלי ראשך:
Rashi on Sotah 45b:16:1.english: You are gozi - You formed [me] from my head, [that is,] my head first, for gozi is an expression of the head, like “Cut off [gozi] your hair” — pluck the hair of your head and uncover your head.

Rashi on Sotah 45b:17:1.hebrew: אפילו תימא אבא שאול - כר' עקיבא סבירא ליה:
Rashi on Sotah 45b:17:1.english: You can even say Abba Shaul - He holds like Rabbi Akiva.

Rashi on Sotah 45b:18:1.hebrew: מ"ט דרבי אליעזר בן יעקב - דאמר מן הצואר הוא קרוי חלל:
Rashi on Sotah 45b:18:1.english: What is the reason of Rabbi Eliezer ben Ya'akov - Who says [that] from the neck he is called slain.

Rashi on Sotah 45b:18:2.hebrew: דכתיב אל צוארי חללי רשעים - והלכך ממנו מודדין, כדכתיב אל החלל:
Rashi on Sotah 45b:18:2.english: As it is written: “Upon the necks of the wicked who are to be slain” - And therefore we measure from it [the neck], as it is written: “to the slain.”

Rashi on Sotah 45b:19:1.hebrew: נפטרו זקני ירושלים כו' - שאין עליהם אלא למדוד, כדכתיב: "ויצאו זקניך ושופטיך ומדדו":
Rashi on Sotah 45b:19:1.english: The elders of Jerusalem took their leave, etc. - For it is only [incumbent] upon them to measure, as it is written: "Your elders and your judges shall go out, and they shall measure."

Rashi on Sotah 45b:19:2.hebrew: ואע"פ שאינו איתן כשר - דלא כתיב ביה עיכובא, ולא נאמר אלא למצוה:
Rashi on Sotah 45b:19:2.english: And even though it is not eitan [forceful], it is valid - For no indispensable requirement is written regarding it, and it was stated only as an optimal commandment [mitzvah].

Rashi on Sotah 45b:19:3.english: With a cleaver - Like a kind of large knife.

Rashi on Sotah 45b:19:4.english: From behind it - Opposite the back of its neck.

Rashi on Sotah 45b:19:6.hebrew: ומותר לסרוק שם פשתן - דוקא נקט עבודה שאינה בגופה של קרקע, כדמפרש בגמרא:
Rashi on Sotah 45b:19:6.english: And [it is] permitted to comb flax there - [The Mishnah] specifically mentioned work that is not on the body of the ground [itself], as [it] explains in the Gemara.

Rashi on Sotah 45b:1:1.hebrew: תניתוה - לחדא מינייהו, דפלוגתא היא בטמון. אבל צף לא פשט לה מינה, דהא אוקימנא טעמא דעליון משום דאחזיק ביה הוא, וצף לא ידעינן מאי הוי עלה:
Rashi on Sotah 45b:1:1.english: You learned it - [This applies] to one of them, for it is a dispute regarding [what is considered] concealed. However, [regarding what is considered] floating, he did not resolve it from [this baraita], for we have established [that] the reason for the upper [sheaf] is because he took hold of it, and [regarding what is considered] floating, we do not know what [the conclusion] is regarding it.

Rashi on Sotah 45b:1:2.hebrew: סברוה - רבנן דבי מדרשא, דבעו למיפשט מינה, דפלוגתא בטמון דמין במינו הוא, דהני תנאי — אפילו תנא קמא דאמר תחתון שכחה — כר' יהודה סבירא ליה דאמר בשדה פרט לטמון, וטעמא משום דמין במינו לא הוי טמון:
Rashi on Sotah 45b:1:2.english: They assumed - [That is,] the Rabbis of the study hall, who wanted to resolve [their question] from it — for the dispute [in the baraita] is regarding a concealed [item] of the same kind — [assumed] that these tanna'im — even the first tanna, who says the lower one is a forgotten sheaf — hold in accordance with Rabbi Yehuda, who says [that] "in the field" [serves] to exclude a concealed [sheaf], and the reason is because one kind [covered] by its own kind is not [considered] concealed.

Rashi on Sotah 45b:20:1.hebrew: לא בא לידינו ופטרנוהו - בגמ' מפרש: בלא מזונות, והיינו "ידינו לא שפכו" — לא נהרג על ידינו, שפטרנוהו בלא מזונות והוצרך ללסטם את הבריות, ועל כך נהרג:
Rashi on Sotah 45b:20:1.english: [He] did not come into our hands and we dismissed him - In the Gemara it explains: without food. And this is [the meaning of] "our hands did not spill" — he was not killed on our account, [i.e.,] that we dismissed him without food and he was forced to rob people, and because of that he was killed.

Rashi on Sotah 45b:20:2.hebrew: לא ראינוהו והנחנוהו - יחידי בלא חבורה, והיינו ועינינו לא ראו:
Rashi on Sotah 45b:20:2.english: We did not see him and leave him - Alone, without company; and this is [the meaning of] "nor did our eyes see."

Rashi on Sotah 45b:5:1.english: Slain - [One] is only called [slain if killed] with an iron implement, like a sword.

Rashi on Sotah 45b:5:2.hebrew: בכולן - ואפי' מפרפר, צף, וטמון ותלוי:
Rashi on Sotah 45b:5:2.english: In all these [cases] - And even [if he is] twitching, floating, concealed, or hanging.

Rashi on Sotah 45b:6:1.hebrew: ומוטל באשפה - דלא הוי צף ולא טמון ולא תלוי, ואפי' הכי אין עורפין, דחלל קבעי. אלמא קרא כדכתיב בעית:
Rashi on Sotah 45b:6:1.english: And left in a garbage [heap] - Where he is neither floating, nor concealed, nor hanging, and even so they do not break [the heifer's] neck, for [the verse] requires [that he be] "slain." Apparently, you require the verse [to be fulfilled] as it is written.

Rashi on Sotah 45b:6:2.hebrew: חלל יתירא כתיב - "הקרובים אל החלל", ועוד חללים טובא, למדרש חלל דוקא ולא חנוק:
Rashi on Sotah 45b:6:2.english: “Slain” is written an extra time - “Who are nearest to the slain,” and many other [mentions of] “slain,” to expound [that it means] specifically “slain” and not strangled.

Rashi on Sotah 45b:7:1.hebrew: פרט למצוי - תדיר, כגון ספר או עיר שרובה עובדי כוכבים:
Rashi on Sotah 45b:7:1.english: Excludes what is commonly found - [That is,] frequent, such as a border or a city whose majority are idolaters.

Rashi on Sotah 45b:9:1.hebrew: קמ"ל כדתניא כו' - והכי קאמר: נמצא סמוך לעיר שאין בה ב"ד, אין מודדין לה, אלא לעיר שיש בה ב"ד מודדין, איזו היא עיר שיש בה ב"ד קרובה לו. ואי לא הדר תניא, הוה אמינא אין מודדין כלל:
Rashi on Sotah 45b:9:1.english: This teaches us as it is taught, etc. - And this is what [the Mishnah] is saying: [If a corpse] was found close to a city that does not have a court, they do not measure to it; rather, they measure to a city that has a court, [to determine] which is the city that has a court closest to it. And had [the Mishnah] not taught [this] again, I would have said [that] they do not measure at all.

Rashi on Sotah 45b:9:2.hebrew: ת"ל ולקחו זקני העיר מכל מקום - דהאי "העיר" קרא יתירא הוא, דמצי למכתב "והיתה העיר הקרובה אל החלל ולקחו זקניה עגלת בקר":
Rashi on Sotah 45b:9:2.english: The verse states: “And the elders of the city shall take” — in any case - For this [word] “the city” is superfluous [in the] verse, as [Scripture] could have written: “And it shall be the city closest to the slain person, and its elders shall take a heifer of the herd.”
